definitions.gloss: to braid in; to weave in; to plait into
definitions.explanation: To interweave or braid something into a larger structure, such as braiding hair, weaving fibers, or incorporating elements into a knitted pattern.

examples.japanese: ⟦リボン→リボン：11256_ribon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{編|あ}み{込|こ}んだ。
examples.english: I braided a ribbon into my hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{色|いろ}とりどり→色とりどり：10404_irotoridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}み{込|こ}んで、⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{模様|もよう}→模様：03635_moyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マフラー→マフラー：04533_mafuraa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I made a scarf with a beautiful pattern by weaving in threads of various colors.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧ (to knit/braid) + ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ (into). The ⟦{込|こ}む→込む：00719_komu⟧ component adds the nuance of weaving something thoroughly into or incorporating it deeply. Most commonly used for braiding hair or weaving materials into fabric/crafts.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — takes a direct object (the thing being braided in).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}み{込|こ}む — to braid hair
- ⟦{糸|いと}→糸：01315_ito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}み{込|こ}む — to weave thread in
- ビーズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{編|あ}み{込|こ}む — to braid beads in
- {編|あ}み{込|こ}みヘア — braided hairstyle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{編|あ}む→編む：00002_amu⟧ — to knit, to braid; the base verb, without the "into" nuance
- ⟦{織|お}り{込|こ}む→織り込む：22764_orikomu⟧ — to weave in; used for weaving fabric, also figuratively for incorporating ideas
- ⟦{三|み}つ{編|あ}み→三つ編み：18439_mitsuami⟧ — a three-strand braid; a specific braiding style
